causal_hypotheses.mtp: On the exact same host, adding only GLM's official MTP/EAGLE configuration improves frozen c8 SLO-goodput by at least 5% without any normalized deterministic output mismatch, paired quality regression, or SLO regression.
causal_hypotheses.stock: The exact GLM-4.7-Flash native-BF16 revision on the pinned stock SGLang container loads on one Nebius H100 and passes the sequential frozen development, 8K/1K c1, and 8K/1K c8 service gates.

falsification_rules.mtp: Reject the MTP hypothesis if exact normalized deterministic identity fails, paired quality rejects or is provisional, any frozen profile fails, or c8 SLO-goodput improvement is below 5%.
falsification_rules.stock: Reject this stock configuration if exact model/runtime identity, load/health, typed workload, development quality capture, artifact, or any sequential SLO gate fails. A provider/bootstrap-only failure changes infrastructure lineage and does not falsify model serving.
